# Load Data
```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("../Data/metag_edna_dna_concentration.csv",header = TRUE,row.names = 1)

# RNA concentrations
rna.conc <- readRDS("../Data/metat.rna.conc.RDS") %>% 
  rename(rna.conc.ng = Total.metaT.RNA..ng..2) %>% 
  mutate(rna.ng.g.soil = rna.conc.ng / 0.5,
         Samples = gsub("virome","",Samples)) # Normalize to g soil (0.5 g used for extraction)

# Virome DNA concentrations
virome.dna.conc <- readRDS("../Data/jgi.final.dna.conc.RDS") %>% 
  select(Samples,dna.ng) %>% 
  rename(Virome.dna.ng = dna.ng) %>% 
  mutate(Virome.dna.ng.g.soil = Virome.dna.ng / 10,
         Samples = gsub("virome","",Samples)) # Normalize to g soil (10 g used for extraction)

edna.abundance <- read.csv("../Data/normalized_abundance_tables/edna_normalized_table.csv",row.names = 1)
rownames(edna.abundance) <- make.names(rownames(edna.abundance), unique = TRUE) #This remove special characters that or originally in the row names
edna.abundance <- edna.abundance[rowSums(edna.abundance) > 0, ]

virome.reads <- read.csv("../Data/normalized_abundance_tables/bulk_virome_normalized_table.csv",row.names = 1) 

metat.reads <- read.csv("../Data/normalized_abundance_tables/active_votu_abundances.csv",row.names = 1)
rownames(metat.reads) <- make.names(rownames(metat.reads), unique = TRUE) #This remove special characters that or originally in the row names

```

#Functions
```{r}
collapse_to_presence <- function(mat, source_name) {
  mat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("vOTU") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -vOTU,
      names_to = "SampleID",
      values_to = "abund"
    ) %>%
    # tweak this extraction to match your naming scheme
    mutate(
      timepoint = str_extract(SampleID, "^T[0-9]+")
    ) %>%
    group_by(vOTU, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(present = as.integer(any(abund > 0)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(source = source_name)
}
```


# Nucleic acid extraction methods

## Normalizing so that 1 is the max value for that nucleic acid type
```{r}
#Create a data frame with all of the nucleic acid concentrations
nucleic.acid.conc <- metadata %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Samples") %>%
  full_join(rna.conc,by="Samples") %>% 
  full_join(virome.dna.conc,by="Samples") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = substr(Samples,1,2)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(-Samples,-timepoint))

summary_df <- nucleic.acid.conc %>%
  filter(
    grepl("soil", name)
  ) %>% # Select for concentrations that were normalized by soil used
  group_by(timepoint, name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>% 
  mutate(name = case_when(
   grepl("eDNA",name) ~ "eDNA",
   grepl("metag",name)  ~ "Total soil DNA",
   grepl("Virome",name) ~ "Virome",
  grepl("rna",name) ~ "Metatranscriptome",
    TRUE ~ name
  ))

stat.df <- nucleic.acid.conc %>% 
    filter(grepl("soil",name),
           !is.na(value)) %>% 
  mutate(name = case_when(
    name == "eDNA_ng.g.soil" ~ "eDNA",
    name == "metag_ng.g.soil" ~ "Total soil DNA",
    name ==  "Virome.dna.ng.g.soil" ~ "Virome",
    name == "rna.ng.g.soil" ~ "Metatranscriptome",
    TRUE ~ name
  )) %>%
  mutate(phosphorus = ifelse(grepl("P",Samples),"Phosphorus","No Phosphorus"))

# First for each nucleic acid source, will find the time point with the highest max mean concentrations
max_value <- summary_df %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  summarise(max_conc = max(mean_value))

normal.stat.df <- stat.df %>%
  left_join(max_value, by = "name") %>% 
  mutate(max_norm_value = value/max_conc)

### First check to see if a linear model is appropriate
sapply(unique(normal.stat.df$name), function(x) {
  df_ <- normal.stat.df %>% filter(name == x) # Select for samples by nucleic acid source
  model <- lm(max_norm_value ~ timepoint, data = df_)
  print(paste0("Shapiro test for:",x))
  shapiro.test(model$residuals)
})

### Metagenome is not normal lets see if we log/sqrt transform helps
model <- lm(log(max_norm_value) ~ timepoint, data = normal.stat.df %>% filter(name == "Total soil DNA"))
shapiro.test(model$residuals) # neither transformation help will run KW on Total soil DNA

### First run test on all non metaG samples
normal.stats <- do.call(rbind,
        lapply(
    unique(normal.stat.df$name[normal.stat.df$name != "Total soil DNA"]),
    function(x) {
      df_ <- normal.stat.df %>% filter(name == x) # Select for samples by nucleic acid source
      lm.mod <- lm(max_norm_value ~ timepoint, data = df_)
      aov.mod <- aov(lm.mod)
      tukey.df <- tukey_hsd(aov.mod) %>% 
        mutate(na.source = x) %>% 
        select(-conf.low,
               -conf.high,
               -null.value) # remove to match other dataframe
    }
  ))

## Run KW on total soil DNA
kruskal_test(max_norm_value ~ timepoint, 
             data = normal.stat.df[normal.stat.df$name == "Total soil DNA",])
non.normal.test <- dunn_test(max_norm_value ~ timepoint, data = normal.stat.df[normal.stat.df$name == "Total soil DNA",], p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>% 
  mutate(na.source = "Total soil DNA") %>% 
  rename(term = `.y.`,
         estimate = statistic) %>% # make column names match with other stat dataframe
  select(-n1,-n2,-p) # remove to match other dataframe

all.stats <- rbind(normal.stats, non.normal.test)

## Generate CLD 
cld.non.normal <- all.stats %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-")) %>%
  group_by(na.source) %>%
  summarise(
    cld = list(multcompView::multcompLetters(setNames(p.adj, comparison))$Letters),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(cld) %>%          # columns named like T0, T1, ...
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -na.source,
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "cld"
  )

# Dodge width
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)
pjd <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.3, seed = 1)

normal.fig.df <- normal.stat.df %>% 
  group_by(name,timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(mean_max = mean(max_norm_value),
            sd_max = sd(max_norm_value),
            se_max = sd_max/sqrt(n()),
          .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(
    y=mean_max,
    ymin = mean_max-se_max,
    ymax = mean_max + se_max
  ) %>% 
  left_join(cld.non.normal,
            by = join_by("name" == "na.source",
                         "timepoint" == "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(y_label = ymax + 0.035 )

normal.fig.df <-stat.df %>% 
  group_by(name,timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(mean_max = mean(value),
            sd_max = sd(value),
            se_max = sd_max/sqrt(n()),
            max_value = max(value),
          .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(
    y=mean_max,
    ymin = mean_max-se_max,
    ymax = mean_max + se_max
  ) %>% 
  left_join(cld.non.normal,
            by = join_by("name" == "na.source",
                         "timepoint" == "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(y_label = pmax(ymax, max_value) + 0.05 * diff(range(stat.df$value)))   # letters above the highest sample

conc.fig.norm.virome <- ggplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = normal.fig.df,
    aes(x = timepoint,
        y = y_label,
        label = cld,
        group = name,
        color = name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.2,
    position = pd,
    show.legend = FALSE
  )+
  geom_line(
    data = normal.fig.df,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = y, 
        color = name, 
        group = name,
        ),
    linewidth = 1.25,
    position = pd,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = normal.fig.df,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = y, color = name),
    size = 2.2,
    position = pd,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = normal.fig.df,
    aes(x = timepoint, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, color = name),
    width = 0.15,
    position = pd,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  xlab("Time point (weeks)") +
  ylab("Normalized nucleic acid concentration")+
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col.lnll, "eDNA" = "khaki3", "Total soil DNA" = "pink2")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(col.lnll, "eDNA" = "khaki3", "Total soil DNA" = "pink2"))+
  labs(color = "Nucleic acid source") +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(
          nrow = 2,
          byrow = TRUE,
          override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2)),
        linetype = "none")
  

```

```{r}
# T0 (Dry) has no phosphorus treatment, so it is plotted but not tested
trt.df <- stat.df %>% 
  filter(phosphorus != "Dry")

### Check normality of residuals for the model that is tested
trt.df %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  group_modify(~ broom::tidy(shapiro.test(residuals(lm(value ~ timepoint * phosphorus, data = .x))))) %>% 
  ungroup()

stat.df %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  group_modify(~ broom::tidy(shapiro.test(residuals(lm(value ~ timepoint, data = .x))))) %>% 
  ungroup()

### Phosphorus vs No Phosphorus within each time point (T1-T3)
# one two-way model per nucleic acid source, then P vs no P compared within each time point
p.stats <- trt.df %>% 
  filter(name != "Total soil DNA") %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  group_modify(~ {
    lm.mod <- lm(value ~ timepoint * phosphorus, data = .x)
    emmeans(lm.mod, ~ phosphorus | timepoint, data = .x) %>% 
      pairs(reverse = TRUE) %>%                         # Phosphorus - No Phosphorus
      as_tibble()
  }) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%   # across time points and sources
  add_significance("p.adj")
p.stats

# By time point, including T0 for this one
edna.time <- stat.df %>% 
  filter(name != "Total soil DNA") %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  group_modify(~ {
    lm.mod <- lm(value ~ timepoint, data = .x)
    emmeans(lm.mod, ~ timepoint , data = .x) %>% 
      pairs(reverse = TRUE, adjust = "tukey") %>%                         # Phosphorus - No Phosphorus
      as_tibble()
  }) %>% 
  ungroup()

time.letters <- multcompLetters(
 setNames(edna.time$p.value, gsub(" ", "", edna.time$contrast))
)$Letters


### Figure
# x offsets: T0 in the centre, No P left, P right
x_levels <- sort(unique(stat.df$timepoint))
p_offset <- c("Dry" = 0, "No Phosphorus" = -0.1, "Phosphorus" = 0.1)

normal.fig.df <- stat.df %>% 
  group_by(name, timepoint, phosphorus) %>% 
  summarize(mean_max = mean(value),
            sd_max   = sd(value),
            se_max   = sd_max / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(y    = mean_max,
         ymin = mean_max - se_max,
         ymax = mean_max + se_max,
         x    = match(timepoint, x_levels) + p_offset[phosphorus])

# T0 is the shared starting point of both treatment lines
line.df <- normal.fig.df %>% 
  filter(phosphorus == "Dry") %>% 
  select(-phosphorus) %>% 
  crossing(phosphorus = c("No Phosphorus", "Phosphorus")) %>% 
  bind_rows(normal.fig.df %>% filter(phosphorus != "Dry"))

y_pad <- 0.05 * diff(range(c(normal.fig.df$ymin, normal.fig.df$ymax)))

star.df <- p.stats %>% 
  left_join(normal.fig.df %>% 
              group_by(name, timepoint) %>% 
              summarise(y_label = max(ymax) + y_pad, .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("name", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(x = match(timepoint, x_levels))

letter.df <- tibble(timepoint = names(time.letters), cld = unname(time.letters)) %>% 
  mutate(x = match(timepoint, x_levels),
         y_letter = max(normal.fig.df$ymax) + 4 * y_pad)

letter.df <- letter.df %>% 
  mutate(cld = chartr("abc", "cba", cld)) # Change the letters so that T0 Starts with a

trt_cols <-col.lnll

conc.fig.norm.edna.trt <- ggplot(normal.fig.df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = phosphorus)) +
  geom_line(data = line.df,
            aes(group = interaction(name, phosphorus), linetype = phosphorus),
            linewidth = 1.25, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.08, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = phosphorus), size = 2.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = star.df,                                      # bracket over each P vs no P pair
               aes(x = x - 0.1, xend = x + 0.1, y = y_label, yend = y_label),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = star.df,
            aes(x = x, y = y_label, label = p.adj.signif),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.3, size = 4.5) +
    geom_text(data = letter.df, aes(x = x, y = y_letter, label = cld),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(x_levels), labels = x_levels) +
  # same name + breaks -> colour, shape and linetype merge into one "Treatment" legend
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Treatment", breaks = c("No Phosphorus", "Phosphorus"),
                        values = c("No Phosphorus" = "solid", "Phosphorus" = "solid")) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Treatment", breaks = c("No Phosphorus", "Phosphorus"),
                     values = c("Dry" = 15, "No Phosphorus" = 1, "Phosphorus" = 16)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Treatment", breaks = c("No Phosphorus", "Phosphorus"),
                     values = trt_cols) +
  xlab("Time point (weeks)") +
  ylab("eDNA concentration (ng/g of soil)") +
  # labs(caption = "Phosphorus vs no phosphorus within each time point: two-way ANOVA contrasts, BH-adjusted") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9)) +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.8)))

```

# Heatmap
```{r}
edna.heatmap.df <- edna.abundance %>% 
  t() %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = substr(sample,1,2),
         time.phosphorus = ifelse(timepoint == "T0","T0",
                                  ifelse(grepl("P",sample),paste0(timepoint," P+"),paste0(timepoint," P-")))) %>% 
  select(-sample,-timepoint) %>% 
  group_by(time.phosphorus) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("time.phosphorus")%>% 
  t() %>% 
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE)

edna.heatmap.df <- edna.heatmap.df[rowSums(edna.heatmap.df) > 0, ]

df__ <- edna.heatmap.df
# Extract time point from column names
timepoint <- substr(colnames(df__), 1, 2)
phosphorus <- ifelse(grepl("T0",colnames(df__)),"Dry",ifelse(grepl("P\\+",colnames(df__)),"P+","P-"))

# Make it a factor (important for ordering & legend)
timepoint <- factor(timepoint, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3"))
phosphorus <- factor(phosphorus, levels = c("Dry", "P+", "P-"))

# Get colors for time points
tp_cols <- col.lnll[c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3")]
p_cols <- c(
  "Dry" = "transparent",
  "P+"  = unname(col.lnll["Phosphorus"]),
  "P-"  = unname(col.lnll["No Phosphorus"])
)

# Get min and max for legend
v_min <- log10(min(df__[df__ > 0]))
v_max <- log10(max(df__))

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(
    log10(1e-6),
    v_min,
    v_min + 0.45 * (v_max - v_min),  # 👈 tight transition
    v_max
  ),
  c(
    "white",
    "yellow2",
    "deepskyblue",
    "deepskyblue4"
  )
)

## Annotations
col_ha2 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Time Point` = timepoint,
  Phosphorus   = phosphorus,
  col = list(`Time Point` = tp_cols,
             Phosphorus   = p_cols),
  na_col = "transparent",
  annotation_height = unit(4, "mm"),
  show_legend = FALSE
)

edna_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  log10(edna.heatmap.df + 1e-6),
  bottom_annotation = col_ha2,
  name = "log10(Mean abundance)",
  col = col_fun,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  column_split = timepoint,
  column_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
  column_title = "Samples",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  row_title = "vOTUs",
  row_title_rot = 90, 
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
  legend_height = unit(60, "mm"),
    at = c(-5, -3,0,2), # when not using custom legend labels, it already uses 2 as max
    labels = c(-5,-3, 0, 2)
  )
)

```

# eDNA richness (Upset)

```{r}
font.size=18
text.size = 15

edna.votu.table.sum <- edna.abundance %>%
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Samples") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = substr(Samples,1,2)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum),.groups = "drop") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("timepoint") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ if_else(. > 0, 1, .))
  )


sets <- names(edna.votu.table.sum)
# count vOTUs present in at least one time point (drops any all-FALSE rows)
n_total <- sum(rowSums(edna.votu.table.sum[, sets]) > 0)

edna.upset <- upset(edna.votu.table.sum, sets, width_ratio = 0.2, min_size = 5,
  name = "Time Point",
  themes = upset_default_themes(text = element_text(size = text.size)),
  base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(
      text_mapping = aes(label = paste0(
        !!get_size_mode('distinct'), "\n(",
        round(100 * !!get_size_mode('distinct') / !!n_total, 1), "%)"
      )),
      text_colors = c(on_bar = 'black', on_background = 'black'),
      bar_number_threshold = 1,
      text = list(size = text.size * 0.25, vjust = -0.1, angle = 0)
    ) +
      ylab('# of vOTUs') +
      ylim(c(0, 5500)) +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  ),
                queries=list(
                  upset_query(set = 'T0',fill = "burlywood4"),
                  upset_query(set = 'T1',fill = "darkblue"),
                  upset_query(set = 'T2',fill = "steelblue2"),
                  upset_query(set = 'T3',fill = "lightblue")
                ),
                matrix=intersection_matrix(
                  geom=geom_point(
                    shape='circle filled',
                    size=3,
                    stroke=0.45
                    )
                  ),
    set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45))
    )
    )
```

# Bar chart
```{r}
source_colors <- c(
  "Virome only"                         = "#1D1160",  # same as col.lnll["Virome"]
  "Virome + Metatranscriptome"          = "#2E8B57",  # sea green: same family as Metatranscriptome (darkgreen)
  "Virome + eDNA"                       = "#FFD08A",  
  "Virome +\nMetatranscriptome + eDNA"  = "#9C89B8"   # lavender: a lighter tint of the virome purple
)

all_pres <- bind_rows(
  collapse_to_presence(virome.reads, "Virome"), 
  collapse_to_presence(metat.reads,  "Metatranscriptome"), 
  collapse_to_presence(edna.abundance,   "eDNA")) %>%
  # wide: one row per vOTU × time point, columns = sources
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols  = c(vOTU, timepoint),
    names_from  = source,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  )%>%
  filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))) > 0)


df_virome <- all_pres %>%
  filter(Virome == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    source_combo = case_when(
      Metatranscriptome == 0 & eDNA == 0 ~ "Virome only",
      Metatranscriptome == 1 & eDNA == 0 ~ "Virome + Metatranscriptome",
      Metatranscriptome == 0 & eDNA == 1 ~ "Virome + eDNA",
      Metatranscriptome == 1 & eDNA == 1 ~ "Virome +\nMetatranscriptome + eDNA"
    ),
    source_combo = factor(source_combo, levels = c("Virome + eDNA",
                                                   "Virome +\nMetatranscriptome + eDNA",
                                                   "Virome + Metatranscriptome",
                                                   "Virome only"))
  )


df_bar <- df_virome %>%
  distinct(timepoint, source_combo, vOTU) %>%
  count(timepoint, source_combo)

bar_fig <- ggplot(df_bar,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = n,
           fill = source_combo)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = source_colors) +
  labs(
    y = "Number of virome-detected vOTUs",
    x = "Time point (weeks)",
    fill = "Mapped Reads Group"
  ) +
  theme_pubr()+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     limits = c(0, 15000),
                         breaks = seq(0, 15000, by = 2500))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.1))+
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    )
``` 


# Bring it all together
```{r}
## Heatmap fonts to match the ggplot panels (run before building edna_heatmap)
ComplexHeatmap::ht_opt(
  heatmap_column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
  heatmap_row_title_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 15),
  heatmap_column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
  legend_title_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  legend_labels_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 12)
)
# In HeatmapAnnotation(col_ha2), also add: annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14)

## Figure dimensions, so the heatmap is drawn at its final size
fig.w <- 15.1; fig.h <- 9.5
right.w <- fig.w * 1    / (0.75 + 1)     # right column share of the width ≈ 8.6 in
ht.h    <- fig.h * 1.1  / (1.1 + 0.65)   # heatmap share of the right column ≈ 5.7 in

ht_grob  <- grid::grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw(edna_heatmap),
                                wrap.grobs = TRUE,          # <- the fix
                                width = right.w, height = ht.h)
ht_as_gg <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(ht_grob)

## Panel A: move the legend into the empty upper-right area, so it can't be read as D's
panel.A <- conc.fig.norm.edna.trt +
  labs(color = "Soil treatment", fill = "Soil treatment") +
  theme(legend.position        = "bottom",
        # legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.85),   # adjust so it misses the letters
        # legend.justification   = c(1, 1),
        legend.background      = element_blank())

lab.font <- list(size = 20, face = "bold")

left.pan <- ggarrange(panel.A, bar_fig,
                      ncol = 1,
                      labels = c("A", "C"),          # was A, D
                      font.label = lab.font)

right.fig <- ggarrange(ht_as_gg, edna.upset,
                       ncol = 1,
                       labels = c("B", "D"),         # was B, C
                       heights = c(1.1, 0.65),
                       font.label = lab.font)

final.fig <- ggarrange(left.pan, right.fig,
                       ncol = 2,
                       widths = c(0.75, 1))

ggsave("../figures/figure3.png", final.fig, width = fig.w, height = fig.h, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../figures/figure3.svg", final.fig, width = fig.w, height = fig.h)   # svg ignores dpi
```
